# iliad-099 (16.1–100) — review, pass 1 (units only)

Method: every note label checked against the form and line; every cross-reference checked against the published parts in the repository root (iliad-002, -004, -011, -047, -052, -057, -070, -071, -098); every house rendering checked against `conventions.md` and `../odyssey/conventions.md`; Greek read word by word against `l`, then `l` against `i`; quotation marks and `p`/`mark` checked. `t` was not touched: the concatenated words of all units equal the packet's 701 words, in order, and every unit's `t`, `l` and `i` have the same number of lines where they should. Units are numbered by their `ln` (and "a"/"b" where two units share one).

Scansion flags: none in the packet; nothing to scan or add.

Quotation marks: “ opens at 16.7 (mark) and ” closes at 16.19; “ at 16.21 and ” at 16.45; “ at 16.49 and ” at 16.100; the narrator's units (16.20, 46, 48) are outside speech. `p` is on 16.1, 16.20 and 16.46, as the packet's ¶ marks require. All correct, no change.

16.43b (own unit, 11.801 in iliad-070): `t`, `l` and `i` compared by script with the published unit: identical. No change.
16.19 (own unit, iliad-004 at 1.363): `t`, `l` and `i` identical to the published unit. No change.

Severity: HIGH = a binding rendering broken or a false statement of fact or grammar to the reader; MEDIUM = sense, force or an unsupported or wrong claim; LOW = precision, polish, wording of the note.

## Considered and refused (no change)

- **νηπίη (16.7–8) "a little child" / "a little girl"**: refused. νήπιος is "foolish" for adults (2.38, Odyssey 9.419) and an infant for a baby (Odyssey 11.449); a girl running beside her mother cannot be "foolish", and the note says the word means a small child here and why. Consistent with the table's κούρη "girl".
- **γλαυκὴ θάλασσα "the gleaming sea"**: refused. Same root as γλαυκῶπις, for which "gleaming" is fixed and reserved; the note says the colour is not fixed. No Odyssey or Iliad row for γλαυκός alone exists to conflict. (Alternatives "grey/blue-green" would decide the open question.)
- **ἐκδῦμεν as infinitive**: refused. The dative νῶϊν "for us two" calls for an infinitive (a subjunctive would take the nominative νῶϊ), the English `i` "might slip out" is the wish construction and the note says so.
- **ἐμβήῃ "step in"**: refused as a rendering (see #35 for the note).
- **κῆρα "death-fate" / "spirit of death"**: matches the table pair (Odyssey 15.275, Iliad 2.859). The note on κήρ/κῆρ is true.
- **ὀχθήσας `l` "vexed", `i` "troubled" (16.48)**: matches the table pair exactly (1.517, 7.454, Odyssey 15.325).
- **ἀμήχανος "past all dealing with" / "impossible to deal with" (16.29)**: matches the Iliad row at 10.167; the note says why not the Odyssey's "helpless".
- **ἱππεῦ / ἱππότα both "horseman"**: the table fixes ἱππεύς "horseman" (4.297) and ἱππότα "horseman"; no conflict.
- **τέλος μύθου "the purpose of my word" (16.83)**: the table has "end" (3.290) and "fulfilment"; "purpose" is the drafter's reading of τέλος, flagged in new-renderings.md and in the note. The sense is arguable either way; kept, not changed.
- **ὅ τε … προβεβήκῃ "or ‘because he’" (16.54)**: the alternative is stated in the note and the English takes the relative; left as a disclosed ambiguity.
- **πιφαύσκεαι "announcing" (16.12)**: the table has "make known" (10.478) with "signal" in one place; "announcing" is not in the avoided lists and is close enough. Left.
- **ἃμα with rough breathing (16.38)**: the note records it as the edition prints it; left.
- **αἰγίλιπος "sheer"**: kept (guess stated in the note, consistent with iliad-052 and 13.63).
- **Cross-references verified and correct**: 1.201 (iliad-002), 1.363–364 (iliad-004; Thetis to Achilles), 8.147 (iliad-047; Diomedes speaking), 9.648 (iliad-057; Achilles to Ajax), 2.371 (iliad-011), 11.660/662/801/802 (iliad-070), 11.794 (iliad-070), 10.167, 11.800 (ἀναπνεύσωσι), 15.704 (via iliad-098).
- **Metre**: nothing flagged by the scanner; no sentence added.

# iliad-099 — review, pass 2 (units re-check, gloss.json, new-renderings.md)

Method: units.json re-read after the pass-1 edits (every note against its own `l`/`i`, grammar labels against the line; `t` untouched, checked by comparing every `t` before and after). Cross-references re-confirmed in the repository root (iliad-052 for 9.14–15, iliad-071 at 11.825, iliad-070 at 11.658–659, iliad-057 at 9.646–653, iliad-011 at 2.371). gloss.json: all 96 new entries and 13 broadened entries checked against every line they occur in, by script for form (under 230 characters, only ’, `lemma — meaning` shape, no line numbers, no "here", every key is a form of this part, no key already in the root glossary, every `__broaden__` entry = the root entry whole + " · " + the new reading), and by hand for lemma, parse, case/tense/mood and meaning. The 408 known forms were read against the root glossary for coverage of their use here.

Severity: HIGH = a false statement of fact or grammar to the reader; MEDIUM = sense, wrong lemma, or a claim the text does not support; LOW = precision, polish, consistency.

## Checked and left (no change)

- **ὀπὸς (broadened)**: second reading "ὄψ, ὀπός — voice; fem. gen. sg." is right for 16.76 (the accusative would be ὄπα); old plant-juice entry whole inside. Kept.
- **περιάγνυται**: unit 77's note already says the sense is known only from the parts; gloss now agrees.
- **προτετύχθαι**: perfect infinitive passive of προτεύχω (cf. τετύχθαι); kept as a parse, with the hedged meaning.
- **ἀκαχοίμεθα**: aorist optative middle of ἀκαχίζω (reduplicated aorist), potential with κε; kept.
- **ἐξέκλυες**: aorist 2 sg. of κλύω with ἐκ-; parse kept.
- **ᾤκτιρε**: aorist 3 sg. of οἰκτίρω with augment; kept.
- **κεκλίαται**: perfect 3 pl. of κλίνω in -αται; subject the Argives; kept (with the meaning corrected, #8).
- **ἀμήχανος**: masc. nom. sg. of the two-ending adjective, said of Achilles; kept.
- **ἔφην**: imperfect 1 sg. of φημί with a future infinitive (καταπαυσέμεν) in indirect speech; kept.
- **κρήδεμνα**: neuter plural of κρήδεμνον; the Odyssey (13.388) parallel was verified by pass 1; meaning hedged (#6, #12).
- **ἐμβήῃ, ἐκδῦμεν, ἴσκοντες, ὤσαιμεν, ἀπονάσσωσιν, ἐναύλους, θάρσυνος, πτόλεμος, μηνιθμός, τύνη, ὤμοιιν, Τυδεΐδεω**: parse checked in each place; πτόλεμος, τύνη, ὤμοιιν (root entry has the dual dative of place) and Τυδεΐδεω are already in the root glossary and cover their use; θάρσυνος (fem. nom. sg., no dative) is correctly broadened.
- **προσέφης** impf. 2 sg.: kept (the root's προσέφη is marked aor.; not rewritten).
- **βεβίηκεν**: root entry "press hard, come upon" differs in tone from the unit's "overpowered"; the parse is the same, not rewritten.
- **The other 12 `__broaden__` entries** (εἰδείη, θάρσυνος, θήῃς, μήτέ, πρόες, ἀμύνῃς, ἀφίκηται, ἐθέλῃσιν, ἔπι, ὀπὸς, ὄφρ, ὥς): the old entry is whole inside the new one, each new reading is correct for its line (ἐπήν + subj., αἲ γάρ … φύγοι, ὁπότ’ ἂν + subj., ὁππότε δή + subj., ὄφρ’ ἀνέληται without ἄν, ὥς τοι … θείω, ἔπι = ἐπί after its noun with ὀλέκονται, etc.).
- **Format**: 96 new entries, all under 230 characters, ’ only, no line numbers, no "here"; no key already in the root glossary; every form of the part has an entry.
- `t` unchanged in all units (compared before and after the pass-2 note edits); `l` and `i` not touched in pass 2.
